meta.instrument: w71 faithful mapper (imported from scripts/w71_probe3_arenas.py): point sources/sinks, is_floor carve-out, position validity filter, spawn nudge, 40x40 raster, 400-sweep Jacobi, free-cell conductance 1

metrics.difficulty: potential_spawn = Jacobi potential at the agent spawn (injection) cell
metrics.positive_structure: fraction of floor (non-wall) cells with potential > +0.45
metrics.negative_structure: fraction of floor cells with potential < -0.3
metrics.note: pinned +1/-1 source/sink cells are floor cells and are included in fractions
